candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.role_title: Student assistant in the field of "Semantic Music Technologies"
letter.opening: I am applying for the Student Assistant position in Semantic Music Technologies. Applying deep learning to real media data is what I enjoyed most in my B.S. in Artificial Intelligence, and working on music information retrieval at Fraunhofer IDMT, right on my own campus, is a perfect fit with my M.Sc. at TU Ilmenau.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence, where I built computer vision and NLP projects in PyTorch. Before my Master's I worked as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea and at TallyMarks Consulting, validating and reconciling data for company reporting.

achievements.impact: in my thesis team I created training data, evaluated and tuned an EfficientNet-B0 model and built the FFmpeg pipeline that cut highlight videos from detected events
I built a PyTorch retinal OCT classifier reaching 94.11% accuracy, including all preprocessing and augmentation
I created labelled training data for my thesis and validated and reconciled business data in industry

letter.problems_section: I would support your team by implementing and porting deep learning algorithms in Python, extending methods for tasks such as annotation, similarity or instrument recognition, and doing careful manual annotation of audio, video and images. Audio signal processing would be new to me, and I am motivated to learn it quickly in your group.
letter.closing: I live and study in Ilmenau and am available immediately for up to 20 hours per week. I would be glad to discuss how I can contribute.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
